name: Genub
description: A young man who searches for his lover Makare and is killed by her after she is turned into an Eternal.

timeline.summary: Genub and Makare flee together from the Eternals, but Genub loses her in the chaos.
timeline.quote: When next he stopped to breathe, Makare was not there.

timeline.summary: Genub finds Makare, now an Eternal with glowing blue eyes, who cuts him down as he reaches for her.
timeline.quote: Hers was not the only blade that punctured his flesh, but it was the first.

relations.note: first blade to strike him, as an Eternal
